source: Site-wide rules and decisions: HubSpot comments (Sarah, 24 Aug), Melinda's 8 Sep email, the 8 Sep call, Patrick's 9 Sep email

comments.t: WEBSITE WIDE: Remove any instance of "custom formulation". Update all instances of FoodScience Corp to FoodScience LLC. Update all instances of "private label" with "Praxera". Footer: update "Praxera is part of the FoodScience LLC family of brands…" and remove the "sibling brand" sentence. Do not connect with DaVinci — remove any instance of that word.
Replace all instances of "manufacturing" / "manufacturer" with Provider language. Caveat: "turnkey production" and "US manufacturing" are OK.
No links from Praxera to DaVinci, and no purchase path / e-commerce on Praxera. Product-guide style CTAs go to Schedule a Consultation (/get-started).
Praxera is never marketed as manufacturing. "Manufactured in the U.S." and "cGMP facility" are approved; never "we produce", "our facilities", "manufacturers".

FDA Disclaimer box — should have an * at the very beginning and each page reflect the same box. Throughout the pages, many claims are made where I have added * which is why it needs to connect to the FDA disclaimer box.
While likely already on your radar, the entire website will need to also be reviewed by our Regulatory team.
TM — on some pages Daily Best products have TM after Daily Best and some pages do not. These should be consistent.
Fish Oils & Omega Category Page — I recommend this be added as EFAs are a top category in our business along with some upcoming potential.

Subheaders — several category pages still have the same general placeholder subheader. The 8 that need to be updated: Multis, Immune, Cognitive, Pediatric, Joint, Heart, Detox & Liver, Energy. I wrote Prenatal and (I believe) Men.

Tagline — has marketing determined a tagline to have under Praxera? Taylor's options: "Helping Practices Build More Than Patient Loyalty." / "Applied Expertise. Built for Your Brand." / "Expert Formulations. Your Brand." Essence: helping practitioners build successful supplement brands through expertise, partnership, and execution.
Dropshipping — we have a page for it. @Tammy Johnson please confirm whether or not this should be included.
When ready, I will review everything again and perhaps that should be done in parallel with Regulatory to provide page approvals.
Keep the ® after Daily Best everywhere (registered mark) — do not reduce to TM. Must be consistent on every page.

Category-page "formulations" block — use Women's Health as the model on every category page: headline "Praxera's <category> formulations available for private label"; line 1 "A selection of our existing <category> supplement line, available for private label today."; "Schedule a consultation for the full catalog and custom options." on its own line. Replace the "Our …", "Real Praxera …", "These are actual products … Browse the full catalog" variants.

"Developed by Us, Made for You" block must appear on every page with identical wording; add "and tested ingredients" after "thoroughly researched" (as on the home/pillar page). Only 43 assets use the global version and about half the pages were locked to Mindy — audit and standardise.

Placeholder hero subheaders on the new category pages: lift the regulatory-approved intro copy from davincilabs.com/shop-supplements/<category>.html (Patrick's suggestion, Tammy: "absolutely perfect, all approved by regulatory"). Pediatric's original names Little DaVinci and cannot be reused verbatim.
Navigation must stay fixed while scrolling (Tammy agreed). Sticky header shipped 8 Sep evening via Global Header module.css. Steps sections should show numbers OR icons, not both.

Regulatory needs ONE WEEK on the live-looking site (they have no HubSpot access — live URLs, not the editor). Soft launch ~14 Sep, nobody pointed at it; public by end of September. Friday 12 Sep touch-base added. QBS (Barb, Yelena, Patrick) checks Justin's changes before the client is asked to review again.

Emails & workflows: reply-to becomes info@praxerasupplements.com (Sarah confirmed the mailbox) — change at the last second, not before. Email footer is the universal DaVinci brand footer — DO NOT EDIT until Patrick builds the Praxera brand kit and re-clones. Audit CTAs/links in the 111 cloned emails; switch-over is DaVinci PL workflows off / Praxera on, same day. Barb + Justin QA the website, Yelena the other assets.

Third-party-testing / NSF / USP passages in the Definitive Guide are long-running general educational content, not new copy — leave them alone. Dropshipping page comes out of the launch set (may return later as an educational resource).

Minimum viable product for the Regulatory hand-off next week: all core pages checked with label-claim asterisks in the right places; guides created and in place; menu navigation updates and links checked; blog populated (start the SEO switch). Until end of month: emails reviewed and corrected; CTAs checked and links confirmed; 301 redirects set up and Google Search Console; workflows tested. Expect an Awareness, Consideration and Decision-stage workflow, each with 6–8 emails. Progress check 4pm today.

We are getting mired in phrasing adjustments to copy that was already approved and published on the existing DaVinci site. Focus this week: tie up the few open pieces, then start QA on the automated emails and workflows.
